arguments.summary: Five unique executed multifamily rent comps within 1.72 miles of the subject and dated 2026-02-05 to 2026-06-09 were selected and ranked by proximity: R1298 (ALDER-REN-19075), R9957 (amended), R2302, R6740 (gross with expenses), and R6049. Effective net rents ($/sf/yr) were computed per the client convention with 2.5% annual bumps, free rent applied at lease start, gross expense deductions each month, and TI subtracted once. Eight records met eligibility before deduplication; duplicates and the five-comp limit reduced the shortlist to five. An executed amendment after the cutoff (U-R2302-2) and an unsigned draft (U-R6740-3) were correctly ignored; an executed amendment within the window (U-R9957-1) was applied. A comp-grid XLSX with citations was created (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).
limitations: Assumes free rent is applied at the start of the term, consistent with the convention; timing of TI disbursement and expense seasonality ignored by the undiscounted method.
Face rent escalation is modeled as step-ups at months 13, 25, etc.; no mid-year proration or partial-year stubs were provided.
Rounding may cause minor presentation differences versus internal systems.
